The loop in cart_total uses range(len(items) + 1)
The loop uses 'for item in items' which iterates directly over items, not
'range(len(items) + 1)'. The code shown does not use range() at all.
The loop in cart_total reads past the end of items
The loop iterates directly over items using 'for item in items', which
safely iterates only over existing elements. There is no range() call that
could read past the end of the list.
The change moves tax into cart_total

calculation to the total. The code changes from returning `total` to
